verdict.rationale: gstack's autoplan skill runs multiple review skills 'sequentially with auto-decisions' and the ship skill automates test/review/version/changelog/commit/push/PR without describing manual steps, suggesting some non-interactive automation potential, but there is no explicit documentation of a headless CLI mode, CI/CD integration, or running gstack outside an interactive AI-agent host (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), a documented headless/non-interactive invocation flag, and confirmation that skills can run without an attached agent session.
